title: "Cycling Analytics"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    self_contained: false
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: 
      version: 4
      bootswatch: flatly
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
libs <- c("flexdashboard","tidyverse","plotly","leaflet","lubridate")
purrr::walk(libs, ~library(.,character.only = T))

dashboard_stage <- function(stage_name, expr) {
  if (exists("run_dashboard_stage", mode = "function")) {
    run_dashboard_stage(stage_name, expr)
  } else {
    force(expr)
  }
}

con <- dashboard_stage("Connect database", {
  connect_db()
})

dashboard_stage("Load data", {
  latest_ride <- get_latest_significant_ride(con)

  latest_ride_streams <- get_latest_ride_streams(con, latest_ride$activity_id)

  latest_ride_efforts <- get_latest_ride_best_efforts(con, latest_ride$activity_id)

  latest_ride_rankings <- get_latest_ride_rankings(con, latest_ride$activity_id)

  activities <- get_activities(con)

  activity_summary <- build_activity_summary(activities)

  activity_streams <- get_activity_streams(con)

  tbr_activities <- get_tbr_activities(con)

  tbr_streams <- get_tbr_position_streams(con, tbr_activities$activity_id)

  tbr_summary <- build_tbr_summary(tbr_activities)

  tbr_calendar <- build_tbr_calendar(tbr_activities)

  tbr_milestones <- build_tbr_milestones(tbr_activities)

  ytd_stats <- build_ytd_stats(activities)

  ytd_streams <- activity_streams |> filter(year(start_date_local) == year(Sys.Date()))

  position_extremities <- get_position_extremities(ytd_streams)

  best_power_efforts <- get_ytd_best_power_efforts(con)

  best_power_effort_streams <- get_best_effort_streams(con, best_power_efforts)
})
```

```{css, echo=FALSE}
#best-efforts .value-box {
  min-height: 92px;
}

#best-efforts .value-box .inner {
  padding: 10px 16px;
}

#best-efforts .value-box .value {
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

#best-efforts .value-box .caption {
  margin-top: 0;
}

#best-efforts .value-box .icon {
  top: 8px;
  right: 14px;
  font-size: 56px;
}

#latest-ride .value-box {
  min-height: 88px;
}

#latest-ride .value-box .inner {
  padding: 9px 14px;
}

.latest-ride-notice {
  align-items: center;
  background: #F5F8FA;
  border-left: 4px solid #AAB7C2;
  color: #52616B;
  display: flex;
  min-height: 76px;
  padding: 14px;
}

.latest-ride-highlights {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 4px;
}

.latest-ride-highlight {
  background: #F5F8FA;
  border-left: 5px solid #F2A46F;
  color: #17324D;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 12px 15px;
}

.tbr-milestones {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 4px;
}

.tbr-milestone {
  align-items: baseline;
  background: #F5F8FA;
  border-left: 4px solid #89A7BF;
  color: #17324D;
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr;
  padding: 9px 12px;
}

.tbr-milestone-date {
  color: #667784;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.tbr-map-status {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  border-left: 4px solid #17324D;
  color: #17324D;
  line-height: 1.35;
  padding: 7px 10px;
}
```

### Distance

```{r}

  if (nrow(latest_ride)) format_latest_metric(latest_ride$distance_metres / METRES_PER_MILE, " mi", 1) else "—",

)
```
